Overview1: This is a question of `what  would you do? if you had to edit and analyse an ego-centric video, according to a set brief
Overview2: We have created a video summariser that does this automatically. it edits the video, gemerates a map that shows where and what the camera filmed
overview3: This Json is to label the unedited videos, which will be used as a GT vs the video the summariser makes
Overview4: populate all the fields as you watch the video. It's in two parts: how the video makes you feel, and what video spans are important , or really not important and should never be included
brief: (read this it shows what the goal is for the summariser): Make a video summary of this video, focussing on X.

video.instruction: how did this video make you feel?

beatsGuide.guide: make one of these for every segment that is either essential for the story, or so bad it must be removed videos are long, so thre is a min and s field to make it easier for you to type and to be machine readable
beatsGuide.start and end times: split up into minutes and seconds to make it easier for you to type, instead of typing 00:00:00:00 each time. you must populate min and sec fields
beatsGuide.Critical_event: mark this 'true' if this is the most important moment. There can be more than 1 of these, but not many
beatsGuide.delete: this is for parts where the lens is blocked, images out of focus, or it's completely unrelated to the story. Just the worst bits.
beatsGuide.tracked_subject: a list of dicts of people and things you want to locate spatially (will be mapped), or analyse how they move (speed etc will be calculated)
beatsGuide.frame_by_frame_analysis: for action packed moments every frame ndergoes 3D reconstrutction for detailed analysis
